title: Super-speed flight on left click
desc: Left click in flight boosts you to 60 blocks a second with a long green trail, afterimages and a ground wake; a hard dive at that speed ends in the big slam.

takes.name: Hold to ramp
takes.facts: hold left click: 20 -> 60 b/s over 1.5 s, release eases back to 20 in 1 s

takes.name: Tap burst
takes.facts: tap: straight to 60 b/s with a sonic boom ring + 16 pixels, holds 2 s, eases back

takes.name: Ramp then dive into the slam
takes.facts: S1 ramp, climb to 16 blocks, hard dive; slam trigger height max(5, 3 x fall per tick) -> S3 M3 slam, 7x7 crater, 0.7 s lock
